# PT Prasasti Adyadma Sentosa (PAS)

> International air & sea freight forwarder based in Sidoarjo/Surabaya, Indonesia, founded in 2017. Member of IATA, ALFI, and WCA World. Services: air freight, sea freight (FCL/LCL), customs clearance, and shipbroker & project/bulk cargo, with offices in Sidoarjo (head office), Jakarta, and Denpasar (Bali).

## Services

- [Air Freight](https://www.prasastiindonesia.com/services-air-freight): Import/export air cargo, direct IATA shipments, consolidation, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge freighter loads, and express courier shipments.
- [Sea Freight](https://www.prasastiindonesia.com/services-sea-freight): FCL and LCL import/export via Tanjung Perak (Surabaya) and major Indonesian and overseas ports, including conventional, out-of-gauge, and break bulk cargo.
- [Customs Brokerage](https://www.prasastiindonesia.com/services-customs-brokerage): Import and export customs clearance with Indonesian Customs (Bea Cukai), documentation, and onward delivery.
- [Project & Bulk Cargo](https://www.prasastiindonesia.com/services-project-cargo): Domestic and international ship chartering, dry bulk cargo (coal, cement, PKE, PKS, fertilizer, steel products), and oversized/heavy-lift multimodal transport.
